column1: # Game profile of Diablo II: Resurrected (Switch, update 1.0.34.0 = v2228224, with Reign of the Warlock; PC build 3.3.94012). Plays on the Mac (the logo movie, the Act I opening cinematic,
# offline hero creation, the Rogue Encampment at 60 fps with sound)
# Blizzard's D2R engine, FMOD, SDK 11.4.3, NVN. The game's data are in Blizzard's CASC storage (data/*.data with text manifests, dm/gfx/tools/casc.py); its shaders are SHAD containers in it
# (data/hd/shaders/*.bin) and 10 records of the same form in main (shader_split.py shad_shaders, raw_shaders). The game allows offline play only within 30 days of a Battle.net login: a rewriter cut
# (patches.py) lets it play offline without one

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)
# every module main imports from (subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie: the logo movie and the cinematics)
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB (3.14 GB on the Mac): a 3328 MB heap region. 2.79 GB physical footprint in the Rogue Encampment
# the NPDM declares no system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false
# the rewritten modules are 72 MB, more than the default 64 MB
# The game asks for present interval 2 (30 fps, as on the Switch); its logic runs on its own clock, so one frame per display tick is 60 fps at the same game speed (the same 3 s walk from the
# Rogue Encampment's start ends at the same place at 30 and at 60 fps)
